user.title: Set Up Presence Based Lighting
user.description: Configure a room with presence-based automation. You'll add entities in the next step.

data_description.room_name: Friendly name for this room (e.g., 'Living Room', 'Kitchen')
data_description.presence_sensors: Sensors that trigger the 'detected' action when any turns on
data_description.clearing_sensors: Sensors that must ALL be off to trigger the 'cleared' action. When configured, these are the clearing authority; trigger-only sensors can turn entities on but do not veto a clear. PBL auto-fills an exact room-level Area Occupancy Detection / Real Last Changed occupancy status when one exists. Leave empty to use the same sensors as triggers.
data_description.activation_conditions: Binary sensors or input booleans that must ALL be on for lights to activate. If presence is detected while conditions are not met, lights will turn on when conditions become true. Leave empty for no additional conditions.
data_description.activation_catchup_mode: Choose which existing occupancy may activate lights when a closed activation gate opens. Fresh presence edges still work normally.
data_description.file_logging_enabled: When enabled, writes integration logs to presence_based_lighting_debug.log in the Home Assistant config folder (capped at 10,000 lines).
data_description.off_delay: Default seconds to wait after presence clears before turning off entities (can be overridden per entity)
data_description.auto_reenable_presence_sensors: Sensors used to track vacancy for the auto re-enable feature. When the room is empty for the threshold percentage during the configured time window, presence lighting will be automatically re-enabled. Leave empty to use the main trigger sensors.
data_description.auto_reenable_vacancy_threshold: Percentage of time the room must be empty during the monitoring window to trigger automatic re-enable (0-100)
data_description.auto_reenable_start_time: Time when the monitoring window starts (default: midnight)
data_description.auto_reenable_end_time: Time when the monitoring window ends and vacancy is evaluated (default: 5 AM)

select_entity.title: Add Entity to Control
select_entity.description: Select an entity to control with presence automation. You've added {added} entities so far.

data_description.entity_id: Select a light, switch, fan, or other entity to control based on presence

configure_entity.title: Configure {entity_name}
configure_entity.description: Configure how {entity_name} responds to presence. Choose 'No Action' to skip an action.

data_description.presence_detected_service: Service to call when presence is detected (e.g., turn_on). Select 'No Action' to do nothing.
data_description.presence_detected_brightness_pct: Brightness used for PBL and intercepted external plain turn_on calls. Existing light entries default to 100 percent.
data_description.presence_detected_transition: Fade duration for a light turn_on action. Existing light entries default to 1 second.
data_description.presence_detected_state: The state the entity should be in after the detection service is called
data_description.presence_detected_state_custom: Enter the exact state you expect immediately after presence is detected. Only used when 'Custom' is selected above.
data_description.presence_cleared_service: Service to call when presence clears (e.g., turn_off). Select 'No Action' to do nothing.
data_description.presence_cleared_transition: Fade duration for a light turn_off action. Existing light entries default to 1 second.
data_description.presence_cleared_state: The state the entity should be in after the clear service is called
data_description.presence_cleared_state_custom: Enter the exact state you expect once presence clears. Only used when 'Custom' is selected above.
data_description.respect_presence_allowed: Allow per-entity presence control via toggle switch. Disable this to make entity always follow presence, ignoring the toggle (useful for always-automated entities).
data_description.automation_mode: Choose how this entity handles manual control. 'Automatic' pauses presence automation when manually controlled and resumes when manually restored. 'Presence Lock' blocks external calls that conflict with presence state.
data_description.control_lease_mode: Off preserves existing behavior. Observe records would-grant telemetry without suppressing PBL. Enforce allows token-guarded external ownership when every safety gate passes.
data_description.control_lease_blockers: Optional entities that must all be off before an enforce-mode lease can be acquired, such as another lighting controller.
data_description.control_lease_correct_late_on: Default-off safeguard that may issue one corrective off only for an exact recent PBL-owned command that converges after an off-direction lease revoke.
data_description.use_interceptor: When enabled and hass-interceptor is installed, this entity proactively blocks conflicting service calls instead of reactively reverting changes. Only applies to Presence Lock mode.
data_description.normalize_external_plain_on: Add this light's configured brightness and transition to external turn_on calls that do not specify brightness or a profile.
data_description.presence_lock_respects_manual_override: When enabled, Presence Lock allows configured manual-off states and disabled presence switches to stand down instead of forcing the entity back on.
data_description.presence_lock_manual_on_override_enabled: Opt in to durable manual On holds for exact root commands. Existing entries remain disabled unless explicitly enabled.
data_description.manual_disable_states: Manual changes to these states pause automation. In Presence Lock mode, these states are treated as manual overrides when 'Presence Lock Respects Manual Override' is enabled. Manual changes to any other state will resume automation. Leave empty to disable manual pause behavior.
data_description.entity_off_delay: Override the global delay for this specific entity (leave empty to use global default)
data_description.rlc_tracking_entity: Select a Real Last Changed sensor that tracks this entity's state. This helps ignore spurious state changes from reboots or unavailability. Recommended sensors are marked with ⭐.
